mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_reports (account_id, request_id, road_address, detail_address, deposit, favorite, favorited_at, risk_level, housing_category, is_trust_property) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{requestId}, #{roadAddress}, #{detailAddress}, #{deposit}, false, NULL, #{riskLevel}, #{housingCategory, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trustProperty})

INSERT INTO report_check_results (analysis_report_id, check_type, risk_level, data_status, evidence) VALUES (#{analysisReportId}, #{checkType}, #{riskLevel}, #{dataStatus}, #{evidence, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO report_fraud_types (analysis_report_id, fraud_type, risk_level) VALUES (#{analysisReportId}, #{fraudType}, #{riskLevel})
INSERT INTO report_fraud_detail_results (report_fraud_type_id, detail_type, risk_level, data_status) VALUES (#{fraudTypeId}, #{detailType}, #{riskLevel}, #{dataStatus})

INSERT INTO analysis_report_checklist_results (analysis_report_id, checklist_item_id, is_verified) SELECT #{analysisReportId}, ci.checklist_item_id, TRUE FROM checklist_items ci WHERE (ci.category, ci.contents) IN
(#{item.category}, #{item.contents})
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, road_address AS roadAddress, detail_address AS detailAddress, risk_level AS result, favorite, favorited_at AS favoritedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM analysis_reports WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY favorite DESC, favorited_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_reports WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT report_check_result_id AS reportCheckResultId, analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, check_type AS checkType, risk_level AS riskLevel, data_status AS dataStatus, evidence FROM report_check_results WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT account_id FROM analysis_reports WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, account_id AS accountId, request_id AS requestId, road_address AS roadAddress, detail_address AS detailAddress, deposit, risk_level AS riskLevel, favorite, favorited_at AS favoritedAt, housing_category AS housingCategory, is_trust_property AS trustProperty FROM analysis_reports WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT report_fraud_type_id AS reportFraudTypeId, analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, fraud_type AS fraudType, risk_level AS riskLevel FROM report_fraud_types WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT detail_type AS detailType, risk_level AS riskLevel, data_status AS dataStatus FROM report_fraud_detail_results WHERE report_fraud_type_id = #{fraudTypeId}
SELECT analysis_report_id FROM analysis_reports WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ai_generate_message_id AS aiGenerateMessageId, analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, title, content FROM ai_generate_messages WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY ai_generate_message_id ASC
SELECT share_token AS shareToken, share_expires_at AS shareExpiresAt FROM analysis_reports WHERE analysis_report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT analysis_report_id FROM analysis_reports WHERE share_token = #{shareToken} AND share_expires_at > NOW()
